statement: Bounded P-256 transfer search: native checks enumerate all nine rational C3 two-torsion Lagrangians and their elliptic-plane containment, the unique C2 rational Richelot matching, a full-size degree-three Velu map with dual, an automorphism-stable mixed E-factor subgroup with six signed images, and an F2 order-three witness excluding a rational P-256-order subgroup by Hasse. No measured speedup or signed geometric theorem is asserted.
